{{Quote|I'm not trying to be your enemy. I'm really not. But the Shipyard docking bay is infested with mynocks.|Maintenance Logs of Jan Stakross|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
The '''Agarrees Shipyard Township''' was a settlement with a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] that was infested with [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]], creatures capable of flight that fed on the energy from power cabling. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jan Stakross]] reported in a maintenance log about knowing an [[Unidentified joyrider|individual]] in a group of [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] was taking a [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] down to Agarees Shipyard Township. Stakross, who was the one who had to take care of the T-16 after the mynocks chewed on the cabling, requested that the individual refrain from taking the T-16 to the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]].

==Description==
{{Quote|You lie down with Kuati, you're gonna wake up with mynocks. Every time.|Jan Stakross|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" />}}
A location with a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]], Agarees Shipyard Township was a place infested with [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]], flying creatures that fed on the energy contained in power cabling.<ref name="MNK" />

==History==
{{Quote|I know one of you is taking the old T-16 out for nightly joyrides.|Jan Stakross|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" />}}
In a maintenance log addressed to a group of [[Sentience/Legends|individuals]], especially to an individual by the name of [[Antilles (Agarrees Shipyard Township)|Antilles]], [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jan Stakross]] claimed to know that [[Unidentified joyrider|one]] of the beings was borrowing a [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]]&mdash;for which the Corporal was responsible&mdash;and occasionally flying it to the Agarees Shipyard Township. Stakross complained that the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] docking bay was infested with mynocks and that the creatures had damaged nearly every bit of the T-16's cabling. In the maintenance log, Stakross lamented having to repair the [[Skyhopper/Legends|vessel]] and begged the joyrider not to return to Agarees Shipyard Township.<ref name="MNK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agarees Shipyard Township was first mentioned in the mynock databank entry of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released on [[October 26]], [[2010]]. Although the maintenance log in the databank entry is addressed to an "Antilles,"<ref name="MNK" /> a [[Antilles|name]] used many times in [[canon]],<ref name="Ep4">{{Film|IV}}</ref><ref name="Ep1">{{Film|I}}</ref><ref name="Ep3">{{Film|III}}</ref> the databank does not specify a particular identity for this name.<ref name="MNK" />
